criteria.evidence: grep of Modules/MedalDomain/Sources shows ZERO import statements — not even Foundation. MedalValueFormatter.swift:24-30 zero-pads with a manual pad2 helper instead of String(format:), keeping the domain framework-free and Kotlin-portable.
Achievement / AchievementSection / AchievementsCase / AchievementStatus / MedalValue / DurationStyle / MedalError / AchievementsRepository / MedalValueFormatter each in a file named after the type.
No force-unwrap/try!/as!/IUO in Sources/. MedalValueFormatter.string(for:) is total (guard let + max(0,·)); the async seam tests use #require (sanctioned).
AchievementsRepository is a protocol; the domain exposes it as the injection seam — the ViewModel (downstream) depends on it, never a concrete.

Tests/MedalDomainTests/Doubles/StubAchievementsRepository.swift is a dedicated LOCAL double — deliberately not the shared MedalTestSupport mock, avoiding a MedalDomain<->MedalTestSupport package cycle (documented in the file).

16 @Test cases across 4 suites cover the spec's done= list: the full formatter matrix (00:00 / 00:00:00 / 23:07 / 2095 ft / nil / negative), earnedCount, isEarned, hasNoMedals, and the async repository seam.

No user-facing strings in the domain (the 'Not Yet' catalog string lives in the feature). The only literals are intrinsic time-math constants (60, 10) in the formatter — not UI magic values that belong in a token.
Public surface matches medal-domain.md exactly; no over-exposure (the pad2 helper is private).
Every type is a Sendable value type; no @unchecked, no @MainActor needed (pure value layer).
